exposure: Delivery mode (vaginal vs. cesarean), Parity (nulliparous vs. multiparous), Offspring sex (male vs. female), Neonatal Apgar scores (<7 vs. >=7), Umbilical arterial pH (UmA-pH) (<7.20 vs. >=7.20)
cohort: 72,869 women with singleton deliveries at and after 37 weeks of gestation from the Japan Environment and Children's Study (2011-2014)
finding: NRFS during labor was associated with an increased incidence of personal-social problems in offspring aged 3 years; however, this association was not confirmed after excluding participants with neonatal Apgar scores <7 and UmA-pH <7.20.
mod_finding: The association between NRFS and offspring's neurodevelopmental delays might vary based on delivery settings.
